objective: Reduce grouped aggregate ORDER BY LIMIT overhead for LDBC Tag popularity and CH-benCHmark rollups by adding a conservative top-N fast path.
out_of_scope: gate profile changes unless current noise requires a separate task

tasks.title: Top-N grouped aggregate ORDER BY LIMIT
expected_changes: Optimize fast-path grouped aggregate ordering when ORDER BY is supported and LIMIT/OFFSET is present.
Avoid fully sorting every group for LDBC `ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10` and CH `ORDER BY SUM(total) DESC LIMIT 20` shapes.
Preserve exact final ordering and LIMIT/OFFSET semantics.
Verify with focused SQL tests, LDBC repeat, production repeat, and benchmark gate.
